title: CHANGE TO NUCLEAR OFFICER BONUS AND INCENTIVE PAY ELIGIBILITY
text: NOAB eligibility will be extended to those selected for commissioning as an LDO(N) starting in Fiscal Year (FY) 2027. b.

title: CHANGE TO NUCLEAR OFFICER BONUS AND INCENTIVE PAY ELIGIBILITY
text: Prospective officers must complete and pass technical screening by Naval Reactors to determine suitability for qualification and continued duty in connection with the supervision, operation and maintenance of naval nuclear propulsion plants. c.

title: CHANGE TO NUCLEAR OFFICER BONUS AND INCENTIVE PAY ELIGIBILITY
text: LDO(N) NOAB will first be available for Sailors selected at the FY27 Nuclear Limited Duty Officer In-Service Procurement Board conducted in February 2026. e.

title: CHANGE TO NUCLEAR OFFICER BONUS AND INCENTIVE PAY ELIGIBILITY
text: Request for payment will be submitted to Navy Personnel Command, Submarine and Nuclear Officer Distribution (PERS-42) utilizing enclosure (3) of reference (a) as an example.

title: CHANGE TO NUCLEAR OFFICER BONUS AND INCENTIVE PAY ELIGIBILITY
text: Payment will be made on the date of commission once PERS-42 has accepted the request.

title: CHANGE TO NUCLEAR OFFICER BONUS AND INCENTIVE PAY ELIGIBILITY
text: This NAVADMIN will remain in effect until reference (a) has been revised.
